fields.description_1: Werken bij EFE combines a large vacancy offer with employer information, core values, reviews and practical context about working at EFE. The challenge was to keep job discovery central while still giving candidates enough information about development, working conditions and the organisation before they apply.
fields.description_2: I structured the WordPress experience around the candidate journey: browse vacancies, open a role, understand the employer and move into a clear application route. Separate company, service and review content supports that journey without distracting from the vacancies, while the responsive layout keeps the same hierarchy on mobile.

fields.description_1: RBMB sells professional building materials for floors, walls and finishing, across categories such as egaline, mortar, primer, floor coatings, plastering products, adhesives, tools and insulation. The webshop therefore needed category depth without making product discovery feel complicated for professionals or capable DIY customers.
fields.description_2: I organised the WooCommerce experience around clear categories, product search, product detail and practical buying support. Advice content and contact options sit close to the assortment, so visitors can move from identifying the right material to ordering or asking for help without losing context.

fields.description_1: Enspect specialises in electrical inspections such as SCIOS Scope 8, 10 and 12, NEN 1010, NEN 3140 and thermography, alongside engineering and technical advice. The website needed to explain these different inspection routes clearly for companies that may be working from insurer, safety or compliance requirements.
fields.description_2: I structured the WordPress content around the inspection types, practical process and next step. Technical subjects are broken into readable service pages with clear context, while quote access and supporting knowledge content help visitors understand which inspection fits their situation before making contact.

fields.description_1: Leeuw Beveiliging needed a professional WordPress presentation that makes its security offer understandable quickly and gives business visitors confidence before they make contact. The project called for clear service language, visible credibility and a direct route from first impression to enquiry.
fields.description_2: I organised the page around the security offer, trust information and the next action instead of repeating general sales language. Shorter content blocks and a consistent responsive structure make the services easier to scan and keep contact options visible across desktop and mobile.

fields.description_1: Doctorcura is a digital healthcare platform where visitors move from treatment discovery into a structured medical process. The website needs to explain treatments, the online medical questionnaire, clinical review, pharmacy fulfilment and delivery information clearly enough for users to understand the steps before they continue.
fields.description_2: I structured the WordPress experience so treatment information, process steps, FAQs and trust content remain separate but connected. Clear next actions guide visitors from choosing a treatment to the medical questionnaire, while supporting information about doctors, pharmacies and delivery stays available without overwhelming the main journey.

fields.description_1: Koelcellenbouw focuses on specialist B2B projects such as custom cold rooms, freezer rooms, cleanrooms and turnkey installations. The website therefore needed to present technical capabilities in a way that helps companies understand the available solutions before requesting advice or a quotation.
fields.description_2: I organised the WordPress content around the main project types, practical service information and clear quotation routes. The structure keeps technical subjects readable, gives each service enough context and keeps contact options close to the points where a business visitor is ready to discuss a project.

fields.description_1: ZEN provides inspection, testing and certification services for oil, gas and chemical commodities, with work spanning laboratory analysis, cargo inspection, marine surveys and related quality and compliance services. The website needed to separate this broad technical offer while keeping accreditation and sector expertise visible.
fields.description_2: I structured the WordPress experience around distinct service areas and technical decision paths. Visitors can move from inspection, testing or certification into more specific services such as cargo inspections and marine surveys, while supporting trust information and direct quote access remain close to the content.
